scope: Exact deterministic checks and fixed-corpus certificate comparison; no runtime or biological validation claim

data_plan.existing_mixed: Recreate all 200 Stage43 mixed cases using identical seed 430317, tree/trial loops, source draws, pendant, noise, alpha and rho; assert every archived case summary matches. Compare old mass screen, new path screen, and their intersection. No instance dropping.
data_plan.heteroscedastic: For the same 200 generating instances use d_upper[r]=truth[r]+epsilon*(1+(leaf_index mod 4))/4 and d_lower[r]=truth[r]-epsilon*(1+(leaf_index mod 5))/5. Compare path upper bounds with all branch-pair brute force; verify no true edge excluded.
data_plan.one_source: Same 20 tree/edge targets as Stage43; nominal exactly target, fixed pendant lower bound=1, alpha=rho=1/4; epsilon ratios 0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1,5/4,2 times alpha*rho*minimum_edge_length. Retain all 140 cases; compare old and new screens, verify theorem at ratios<1.
data_plan.sharpness: Unit three-leaf star target arm0 center-distance3/8; alternative arm0 weight3/4 center-distance1/2 and arm1 weight1/4 center-distance1/4, pendant1; alpha=rho=1/4. Verify sup discrepancy=1/16 and strict versus equality screening.

metrics: fast branch score equals exhaustive branch-pair score
claim_boundary: Path metric/Gromov-product identity and message passing are classical. Target is a sharper PDD conditional corollary; generating counts are not identifiable in general.
